titre: Selling with a quiz: the CAPTO® method in 5 steps
description: Your quiz collects leads but nothing sells? The CAPTO® method, five links in a chain, to sell with a quiz from the first email to the follow-up.

blocs.html:
TL;DR

Your quiz does a great job on the first three links of the CAPTO method: it captures, it attracts, it profiles.

But collecting emails has never filled a bank account.

What you are missing are the last two links, Transform and Optimise, meaning the right emails sent to the right profile, then the adjustments your real numbers point you to.

Here is the full chain, from the first click to the sale.

Your prospects leave their email in your quiz but they never buy?

You are not alone, and more to the point, your quiz is not the culprit.

It runs, the leads come in, and at the end of it all, nothing. No sale, or one here and there, purely by luck.

The real problem is that you were taught to capture emails and everyone stopped right there, as if collecting an address were enough to trigger a purchase.

The numbers say otherwise, and they are brutal: roughly 79% of leads never become customers when they are left to fend for themselves after the capture (MarketingSherpa).

In other words, your method is not bad 👉 you are just missing a few essential steps.

blocs.texte: Why your quiz captures emails but does not sell

blocs.html:
Because capturing is only the first link in a chain, never the finish line.

I built a method for selling with a quiz and it has a name: CAPTO®.

It describes the five steps a stranger goes through to become a customer:

  • Capture,

  • Attract,

  • Profile,

  • Transform,

  • Optimise.

Your quiz handles the first three almost on its own, and that is already a strength most people will never have.

But nobody buys simply because they handed over their address.

The sale is won on the last two steps, and that is exactly where everyone comes unstuck, for lack of knowing how to go about it.

blocs.texte: The CAPTO® method, from quiz to sale

blocs.html: CAPTO is the five steps a stranger goes through to become your customer, and your quiz is the engine that pulls them from one end to the other.

blocs.alt: The CAPTO method as five links: Capture, Attract and Profile, which the quiz takes care of, then Transform and Optimise, which you build yourself

blocs.html:
Here are the 5 steps to follow, in this order:

CAPTURE: your quiz picks up the email by offering an experience instead of shoving a form at people, so they fill it in happily.

ATTRACT: because a quiz makes people want to share it, it brings you free, qualified traffic while you sleep.

PROFILE, the clever link: with every answer, your quiz files the person into a precise profile and tags them, so you know exactly who you are talking to before you write a single word.

Then come the two links where everything is decided:

TRANSFORM, first: you follow up with the right emails and the right offer, cut for each profile, all the way to the sale.

OPTIMISE, last: you read your real numbers and adjust as you go, so your chain tightens with every new batch of visitors.

Your quiz forges the first three links almost on its own.

The last two are yours to build, and that is precisely where all your revenue is sleeping.

blocs.texte: The first three steps come with your quiz

blocs.html:
No need to dwell here, and that is good news.

Your quiz captures because it offers an experience rather than demanding an address, which is why 44.9% of the people who start a quiz leave their email in coaching and training (Interact report), when a classic opt-in tops out at 1 to 3% from what I see going past.

blocs.alt: A classic form captures once; an interactive quiz captures 2 to 3 times more, with the email, the profile and the need

blocs.html:
It attracts because a quiz makes people want to share it, which brings you free traffic.

And it profiles because with every answer it files the person into a box and tags them, which tells you who you are talking to before you have written a single word.

If you want to dig into those three, I have covered them already: how to create your quiz in Systeme.io, how it collects your emails, and why it far outperforms the classic PDF.

What we are interested in today is what comes next.

The part nobody takes the time to show you.

blocs.texte: Transform: the step where everyone comes unstuck

blocs.html:
Your quiz has captured, attracted, profiled.

Now comes the decisive moment: turning those contacts into customers.

In practice, you send them the right emails and the right offer, cut for each profile, because a message written for everyone reaches nobody.

And this is not a nice-to-have: targeted campaigns can bring in up to +760% more revenue than generic sends (DMA data, via Campaign Monitor).

And here is what makes a quiz so formidable at exactly this moment: with one, you are not selling, you are prescribing.

Remember, your quiz made a diagnosis, and the person recognised their own problem while answering.

So when you put your solution forward, you are not pushing an offer at a wary stranger, you are handing the right remedy to someone who has just admitted they are unwell.

The difference is enormous 🤯

On one side "buy my thing", on the other "here is exactly what you need, you specifically".

The second one meets almost no resistance.

Three simple moves multiply this step.

Your first email goes out within the minute after the quiz, while your name is still fresh and the person still has their result in front of them, because attention drops away at a terrifying speed.

Its subject line picks up the profile they have just been given, something like “Marc, the number one trap for Perfectionists”, which gets opened far more than a one-size-fits-all subject because it is literally about them.

And behind it, you roll out a short sequence built for their profile, which gently brings them to know you, like you, trust you, and then take the step.

blocs.alt: Three moves for selling after the quiz: the first email within the minute, the profile in the subject line, then the sequence know, like, trust, buy

blocs.html:
Nothing clever here, just the right message at the right moment.

(Want to see it on a real case? Take a look at this case study.)

blocs.texte: Optimise: the step we all want to skip... and yet!

blocs.html:
This last link separates the quiz that stalls from the quiz that grows on its own.

Optimising means refusing to fly blind: you look at your real numbers, how many visitors start, where they drop off, which emails get opened, which offer converts, and you correct from what you see, not from what you imagine.

The rule is simple: one observation 👉 one action.

Plenty of people start your quiz but few leave their email?

Your request for an address comes too late, move it up before the result.

Your sequence gets opened but nobody buys?

It is your offer or your timing that needs a rethink.

Every leak has a cause, every cause has a fix, and it is that watchmaker's work that makes a quiz sharpen with each new wave of visitors, instead of going round in circles.

What to take away about selling with a quiz:

  • The CAPTO® method turns a stranger into a customer in five steps: Capture, Attract, Profile, Transform, Optimise.

  • Your quiz forges the first three almost alone. Your sale is decided on the last two.

  • Transform: the right email and the right offer, per profile. And with a quiz, you are not selling, you are prescribing.

  • Optimise: one observation, one action. That is what makes a quiz grow instead of leaving it to stall.

  • Capturing is never the end: without what follows, roughly 79% of leads never buy (MarketingSherpa)

blocs.texte: So where do I actually start?

blocs.html:
If you already have a quiz, you hold the first three links.

Tackle the fourth tonight: one single welcome email, for one single profile, set to go out within the minute.

It is short, it is doable, and it is enough to stop the bleeding of leads going cold in silence.

The rest of the sequence can come tomorrow, and the optimising once you have enough numbers to read something.

If you do not have a quiz yet, start there, it is the engine of the whole chain, and I explain how to build one in Systeme.io.

blocs.texte: FAQ: selling with a quiz and the CAPTO® method

questions.question: What is the CAPTO® method?
questions.reponse:
It describes the five steps that turn a stranger into a customer using a quiz: Capture the email, Attract traffic through sharing, Profile by segmenting on the answers, Transform with the right emails and the right offer, and Optimise by adjusting on your real numbers.

Your quiz handles the first three, you build the last two.

questions.question: I already have a quiz, do I have to start over?
questions.reponse:
No, and above all do not break anything.

Your quiz already covers Capture, Attract and Profile.

You are only adding Transform and Optimise, meaning the email sequence per profile and the reading of your numbers.

You are completing it, not starting again.

Unless your quiz attracts nobody today, obviously...

questions.question: How long does it take, and is it complicated?
questions.reponse:
If you can send an email and copy-paste, you can do this.

The longest part is not the technical side, it is working out what to write for each profile.

That is exactly the part we go through together in the Atelier.

questions.question: Does it work in my field?
questions.reponse:
Yes, whether you are a coach, a freelancer, a consultant, an affiliate or a content creator. The CAPTO® method does not change.

The Atelier adapts to your field, so the examples and the methods speak to you directly.

questions.question: What tools do I need to sell with a quiz?
questions.reponse:
You need a quiz plugged into your emailing tool (Systeme.io), and the only one that exists today is Tiquiz.

The quiz captures and tags by profile, your emailing sends the right campaigns.

That is all.
